naming_boundary: KAS plug-in using voxel-KD as infusion proxy; not full IAD because IAD-specific KIS was not run

start_checkpoint.selection: existing fixed validation selected voxel-KD epoch200

matched_arms.control: KD200 plus 32 epochs teacher-free DiceCE continuation
matched_arms.kas: same continuation plus registered KAS projector and gamma*(MSE+DiceConsistency+Contrastive)

kas.encoder_tap: MONAI SegResNet network.encode down_x[3] after deepest down_layer
kas.upsampling: trilinear to final raw-logit spatial size, align_corners=false
kas.dice_consistency: per-volume soft Dice between sigmoid(projected_raw) and sigmoid(final_raw), epsilon1e-6, batch mean, no detach
kas.negative: (1-sigmoid(projected_raw))+(1-sigmoid(final_raw)); no negative Conv in binary adaptation
kas.contrastive: per-volume flatten cosine InfoNCE, positive final/projected raw pair, negative final/negative representation pair, temperature1, batch mean, stable logsumexp

source_code_caveats: accepted paper binary weights are gamma0.01/delta1 with equal KAS components, while binary source comments downweight MSE/Dice again
official KIS/KAS blocks are commented and active loss is undefined
official projector is created inside each batch and is not registered in optimizer
paper Eq5 shows negative Conv but binary source omits it; project freezes binary no-negative-Conv path
official contrast uses one batch-global cosine; project freezes per-volume cosine to avoid case coupling
official binary code repeatedly uses test for selection; project prohibits this

fixed_training.sampler: weighted replacement, 756 samples/epoch, independent Generator same seed

paired_execution.mode: two independent single-GPU processes, no DDP
paired_execution.batch_hash_gate: first batch case IDs and raw image, augmented image and label tensor SHA256 equal across arms
paired_execution.rng_reset: after model/aux/optimizer/loader construction reset Python, NumPy, CPU torch and local CUDA RNG to20260860

fixed_validation.selection: maximum KAS Scan Dice among epochs208/216/224/232; Subject Dice exact tie-break

promotion_gates_all_required: selected KAS scan and subject Dice strictly beat matched control at same global epoch
selected KAS scan and subject Dice strictly beat original voxel-KD200
selected KAS point hit is no more than one of108 cases below voxel-KD200
paired scan and subject bootstrap95% CI lower bounds versus voxel-KD200 are both at least -0.003
paired first-batch case/raw/augmented/label hashes match and all checkpoints reload/deploy exactly
all implementation, synthetic, paired GPU smoke, hash, role and access gates pass

technical_stop_gates.registration: projector is persistent, present in state_dict and optimizer
technical_stop_gates.loss: segmentation, MSE, DiceConsistency, Contrastive and total finite
technical_stop_gates.gradient: KAS-only projector, deepest encoder and final-logit gradients finite and nonzero; gamma0 update equals control exactly
technical_stop_gates.memory: either arm batch8 peak allocated greater than32GiB
technical_stop_gates.deploy: all saved checkpoints strict reload and stripped plain logits exact

if_gates_fail: stop without gamma, component weight, projector, detach, contrast aggregation, LR, epoch, checkpoint, threshold or postprocessing search; do not access test270
